content: Your inner heat fuels every strike, burning with quiet intensity.
A quiet fire persists within you at all times, lending your attacks a noticeable edge. Every blow carries more force than it should — nothing dramatic, just a steady weight behind each swing.
After attuning to the Fire element, the fire inside of you wants to come out.
Your direct attacks and beginner spells now have a small chance to ignite your opponents for a short time.
